BondHistory.title: BondHistory
BondHistory.description:
The history of an issue for the monitors (DATA_CONTRACT §6). Today: the desk's own default runs, one point
per business date the desk held it; no curve rate yet (``spread_to_curve_note`` says so). Empty, not 404,
when the issue is unknown.

RiskPayload.title: RiskPayload
RiskPayload.description:
First-order and Hessian sensitivities of a run's valued positions, for the Taylor (T1) scenario
estimate: x_i shock per factor, total = sum delta x + sum_(i<=j) (i == j ? 1/2 : 1) gamma x_i x_j.

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: [factor index, RUB per unit]: IR and CS per bp, FX per 1 %; nonzero only

gamma.title: Gamma
gamma.description: [i, j, RUB per unit_i x unit_j], i <= j

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: The default run of its date: the latest complete EOD run on eod_final, otherwise on eod_preliminary (04 §3)

lineage.title: Lineage
lineage.description: EodContext.lineage() plus the run's lineage columns (04 §3)

is_default.description: The default run of its date: the latest complete EOD run on eod_final, otherwise on eod_preliminary (04 §3)

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page

ScenarioDefinition.title: ScenarioDefinition
ScenarioDefinition.description:
The prototype scenario shape. curves: bp per RISK_BUCKETS pillar (11) or one number for all, per
published curve ("RUB OFZ"); ofzSpread: OFZ Z-spread to the KBD, bp; fx: % against RUB (+ = weaker
rouble). Returned normalized: 11-pillar lists, zeros and empty entries left out.

SpreadRules.title: SpreadRules
SpreadRules.description: Credit spread shocks in bp, additive; mult scales the position's own spread (factor > 0).
